title: Tiny flaws in diamonds could unlock a quantum computing revolution
caption:
Researchers have found a faster way to identify defects in diamonds that could power future quantum technology. By treating these tiny structural flaws like molecules, they’ve discovered new ways to manipulate quantum states at room temperature.

Source: Sciencedaily - Tiny flaws in diamonds could unlock a quantum computing revolution

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261111005855.htm
